message.text:
q19.

**REST/HTTP via grpc-gateway — `repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go`**
**Connect (ConnectRPC) — `repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go`** (with wiring in `repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go`)

Both protocols front the same `APIV1Service` business logic, so `MemoService` is reachable two ways.

The gateway path registers the service on a `runtime.ServeMux` and mounts it under `/api/v1/*`:

```108:110:repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go
	if err := v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
		return err
	}
```

```123:129:repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go
	gwGroup := echoServer.Group("")
	// Register SSE endpoint with same CORS as rest of /api/v1.
	RegisterSSERoutes(gwGroup, s.SSEHub, s.Store, s.Secret)
	handler := echo.WrapHandler(http.MaxBytesHandler(gwMux, maxAPIRequestBytes))

	gwGroup.Any("/api/v1/*", handler)
	gwGroup.Any("/file/*", handler)
```

The Connect path is where the wrapping happens — `ConnectServiceHandler` embeds `*APIV1Service` and each generated handler is registered on its own mux:

```40:40:repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go
		wrap(apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...)),
```

That mux is then attached in `v1.go` under the fully-qualified proto package prefix, which is what browser clients hit:

```139:144:repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go
	connectMux := http.NewServeMux()
	connectHandler := NewConnectServiceHandler(s)
	connectHandler.RegisterConnectHandlers(connectMux, connectInterceptors, connect.WithReadMaxBytes(maxAPIRequestBytes))

	connectGroup := echoServer.Group("")
	connectGroup.Any("/memos.api.v1.*", echo.WrapHandler(http.MaxBytesHandler(connectMux, maxAPIRequestBytes)))
```

Two details worth noting: the file comment at `connect_handler.go:19` describes the goal as supporting "both native gRPC and Connect protocols," but there is no standalone `grpc.NewServer` anywhere — the gRPC-shaped surface is served through the gateway using `RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer` (in-process, no network hop). Each protocol also has its own auth layer: a `gatewayAuthMiddleware` for the REST side and Connect interceptors (`NewMetadataInterceptor`, `NewAuthInterceptor`, and others) for the Connect side.
